projection.acceptance: Apply the voice acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
projection.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then reproduce the exact model/runtime as a caller-supplied-asset reference and add an opt-in SDK adapter once its prerequisites pass. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails.

non_claims: No VITS2 source, checkpoint, weights, runtime, config, vocabulary, tokenizer, or generated audio is present, downloaded, imported, linked, or executed.
No real corpus, consented reference voice, listening, device timing, benchmark, or release result is produced or claimed.
No provider registration, descriptor, registry, default, public API/ABI, shared build, CI, board, handoff, ruleset, or main change is made.
No network access or download is attempted; absent artifacts are not fabricated, reconstructed, mirrored, or substituted.
No sibling voice/TTS/VC evidence is inherited, pooled, or treated as this task's result.
Missing, invalid, nonfinite, or adverse cases do not qualify; this package is proposal-only blocker evidence.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide immutable VITS2 source revision, reviewed license text, and per-file digests for the exact canonical implementation.
release_gates.title: Exact source provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide caller-selected exact checkpoint/weights/config/assets with immutable digests and reviewed license, consent, redistribution, and output-use terms.
release_gates.title: Exact checkpoint/assets and rights

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide reproducible pinned runtime and exact task geometry: sample rate, channels, frame/hop/reset/drain or synthesis boundary, and adapter contract.
release_gates.title: Pinned runtime and task geometry

release_gates.reopen_condition: Define a versioned optional adapter boundary preserving installed v0 behavior; no default/API/ABI/shared build change without independent review.
release_gates.title: API/ABI and installed-v0 compatibility

release_gates.reopen_condition: Run deterministic fixture conformance with 3x cold-start byte-identical regen and strict rejection of missing/invalid/nonfinite/adverse cases.
release_gates.title: Deterministic conformance and adverse rejection

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide rights-cleared matched Voice-profile evidence: content preservation, identity/similarity, naturalness, alignment, first-output/tail timing, exact target condition, and controls.
release_gates.title: Matched Voice evidence

release_gates.reopen_condition: Measure paced target-device/runtime CPU, memory, deadline, availability, and failure behavior for the exact configuration.
release_gates.title: Target execution and availability

release_gates.reopen_condition: Obtain exact-head independent review, hosted CI, and explicit release approval; missing/adverse results remain non-qualifying.
release_gates.title: Independent review and release decision
